meta.title: Proposal endpoints all sit behind `add_response?`
gaps: the plan has the vendor send GET /proposal/{{proposalUuid}}, but the supplier app may not call GET /proposal/:id (it is not on agribid_website's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
The vocabulary provides only one proposal-endpoint case, so the other three endpoints are not checked.
The available case covers a vendor reader rather than all callers outside the allowed companies.
warnings: error code 455 is not in en-IN.yml (or the backend checkout is missing) — the message cannot be checked

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error.
